patches.name: Uncensor patch
patches.notes: Install (PC): Open the Steam game install folder (right click the game in Steam, Properties, Local Files, Browse Local Files...) Download the patch archive from the link below Extract the patch archive into the game install folder mentioned above, merging any folders and overwriting any files if prompted It's working if: When you open the game, a screen pops up saying "I see what you did there", and you get the "I see what you did there" achievement. uncensorpat.ch checked this patch on PC.
